event.title: Linux Presentation Day in Berlin, Germany

body.p: The FSFE’s Berlin group invites you to Linux Presentation Day, a hands-on workshop designed to make it easier to switch to or get started with Linux.

Programme
* Talk: What exactly is Linux? How does it work in everyday life?
* Talk: Free software on your smartphone – Free Your Android
* Q&A session to answer your questions about switching to Linux; demonstration devices running Linux available to try out

When: 10 October 2026 // 1 pm to 3 pm
Where: Pablo Neruda District Central Library
Event in German; questions can also be answered in English
